jobs.description: Interested candidates can share their resume to - Sabana.khanam@careernet.in Job Posting Title Principal Software Engineer, GaME Shared BI/Data Foundation Job Description WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH You will report to the Senior Engineering Manager / Director of Engineering and serve as the most senior individual contributor in the organization. You will partner with Directors, Senior Architects, BI Experience leadership, Platform leadership, Data Governance, and Security to set the multi-year technical strategy for how Clinet consumes Marketplace and Client Direct data. You will be a technical force multiplier your decisions influence dozens of teams and millions of dollars of TCO. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for a hands-on technical leader with deep systems intuition, strong opinions held loosely, and a proven record of driving enterprise-wide outcomes. A minimum of 10+ years of software and data engineering experience, including time as a senior or lead IC at a large-scale data-driven company. Mastery of multiple backend languages (Java, Python, Scala) and deep expertise in distributed systems, data modeling, and API design. Architect-level fluency with modern data platforms Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Iceberg, Trino, dbt, or equivalents and with streaming systems (Kafka, Flink). Proven experience designing enterprise consumption layers semantic/ontology layers, governed APIs, metric stores, agentic/LLM-powered analytics surfaces. Strong cloud architecture expertise across AWS, GCP, or Azure: security, cost, resilience, multi-region. A track record of driving large-scale simplifications, decommissions, and migrations across many teams. Demonstrated ability to set technical strategy, write influential design documents, and align senior leaders. Experience partnering with Platform, Security, and Governance organizations to shape enterprise standards. Exceptional written and verbal communication; equally comfortable in deep-code reviews and exec briefings. Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent experience. Preferred: published technical writing, open-source contributions, prior experience leading data-product platforms at retail / commerce / consumer scale. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON As a Principal Software Engineer, you will shape the long-term technical direction of how'Clinets enterprise consumes Marketplace and Clinet Direct data. You will define the multi-year architecture for our governed consumption layers APIs, ontology/semantic models, agentic layers, and data quality systems. You will drive a single source of truth for Client Direct and Marketplace data across the enterprise, in partnership with BI Experience teams. You will lead the aggressive simplification and unification of our data products landscape — picking which systems live, which get decommissioned, and how teams migrate safely. You will co-design with BI Experience teams the agentic and AI-powered consumption experiences that change how business users discover health, insights, and actions. You will set engineering standards (testing, observability, security, performance) and ensure they are adopted consistently across the org's repos. You will influence the Platform team's toolkit, blueprints, and patterns to make sure they serve Marketplace data use cases at scale. You will mentor Leads and Senior engineers across multiple squads, and represent the organization in cross-Client architecture and governance forums. jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer
jobs.description: Interested candidates can share their resume to - Sabana.khanam@careernet.in Role & responsibilities About the role We are building an AI-powered operating model for Ocean Operations and a next-generation optimisation capability for global Network Design. This role is not limited to agent orchestration or execution workflows. It is a senior technical leadership role for how AI strengthens optimisation methods, modelling, and decision quality across both planning and execution. The remit is broader than a standalone AI feature set. It covers how AI, optimisation, and engineering come together to deliver better network decisions at scale, while also shaping agentic decision systems in Control Tower style execution environments. Role purpose The Principal AI Engineer will set the technical direction for AI-augmented optimisation and intelligent operational decisioning. This person will lead through specialists in optimisation, modelling, heuristics, analytics, and experimentation. They will define where AI can materially improve search, structural recommendations, and solver-backed workflows, while also guiding the design of multi-agent systems for reasoning, orchestration, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop execution. What you will own • Technical direction for AI-augmented optimisation and agentic decision systems across Network Design and operational execution • How planning problems are framed and where AI can jobs.title: Senior Electrical Design Engineer
jobs.description: Role Summary Job Title: Senior Electrical Design Engineer - Harness & Systems Experience: 8 -12 years (core hands-on) Location: Doddaballapur, Bengaluru Rural, Karnataka (work from office) Domain: Gaming cabinets, slot machines, EGM - high-reliability electro-mechanical products Design Platform: SolidWorks Electrical only (Schematic + Electrical 3D / Routing) Education: Diploma or B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech - both routes accepted Engagement: Full-time Notice Period: Immediate joiners preferred About the Role You will own the electrical architecture, 3D cable and wire harness design, schematic generation, component selection and design validation for next-generation slot machines and gaming cabinets. This is a role for an engineer who works comfortably in both worlds - the schematic and the physical assembly. You will route harnesses through cabinets where space is tight, doors swing and drawers slide, and where a wire that chafes through after two years in the field is a failure the operator will feel. Everything is designed in SolidWorks, and the harness you draw is the harness the shop floor builds. Requirements Key Responsibilities A. 3D Wire Harness & Cable Design Spatial routing: Design and route complex 3D wiring harnesses, looms and cable assemblies within tight, high-density cabinet spaces using SolidWorks Electrical 3D / Routing. Dynamic kinematics: Engineer harness paths across moving parts - hinged display doors, retractable player-tracking modules and bill validator drawers - with correct strain relief, bend radii and anti-chafing protection. Assembly integration: Work inside the live SolidWorks cabinet assembly to validate clearances, service access and interference against mechanical and sheet-metal models. Production deliverables: Generate 2D formboard and nailboard drawings, Bills of Material (BOM), wire cut lists, sleeve specifications and bundle breakdown sheets for manufacturing. B. Electrical Schematics & Architecture Schematic design: Create and maintain multi-sheet electrical schematics and power single-line diagrams in SolidWorks Electrical Schematic - AC mains entry, 12V / 24V DC supplies, UPS backup and logic isolation. System interconnections: Map wiring between main logic boards (EGM controllers), bill acceptors, thermal printers, player panels, topper displays and RGB LED controllers. Data integrity: Maintain the project database, component libraries, cabling and terminal-strip data so schematics and 3D routing stay synchronised through design change cycles. C. Connector & Component Selection Interconnect specification: Select connectors, pins, headers and terminals (Molex, TE Connectivity, Hirose, Amphenol) for low-power signals, high-speed data and high-vibration environments. Cable sizing & protection: Define wire gauges, insulation types, shielding, ferrites and sleeving rated for continuous operation. Manufacturing standards: Ensure every harness design conforms to IPC/WHMA-A-620 Class 2/3. D. Testing, ESD, Safety & Compliance ESD protection: Implement chassis grounding, shielding and ESD suppression routes that protect sensitive electronics from static discharge at player touch points. Regulatory compliance: Ensure the electrical layout passes gaming certification such as GLI-11, alongside FCC Class A/B, CE, UL 62368-1 and UL 2200. Verification testing: Oversee continuity testing, high-voltage insulation and Hi-Pot tests, thermal load limits and signal integrity checks on harness prototypes. Mandatory Criteria Education - either route accepted Route A: Diploma in Electrical or Electronics Engineering, supported by 8 to 12 years of hands-on wiring harness design and schematic engineering experience. Route B: B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech in Electrical Engineering or Electronics & Communication Engineering. Diploma candidates who meet the experience requirement are assessed on demonstrated project capability, not on qualification. Both routes are evaluated against the same technical bar and the same software requirement below. Software Platform - SolidWorks, no equivalents You must be independently productive in SolidWorks Electrical Schematic for 2D authoring and SolidWorks Electrical 3D / Routing for harness work, including bidirectional schematic-to-3D synchronisation and automated formboard generation. Coming from EPLAN Electric P8, AutoCAD Electrical, Creo Pro-Cabling, CATIA V5 EHI, Autodesk Inventor or VeSyS? You are welcome to apply - but you will need to demonstrate working SolidWorks Electrical capability at interview, as these platforms are not treated as substitutes here. What You Bring Experience: 8 to 12 years in electrical harness design, schematic engineering and cabinet-level system integration. SolidWorks Electrical 3D / Routing: Proven 3D harness routing, flattened-route creation and formboard output within live assemblies. SolidWorks Electrical Schematic: Multi-sheet schematic authoring, library and symbol management, terminal-strip and cabling definition, report generation. Standards: Working knowledge of IPC/WHMA-A-620, crimp validation, pull testing and harness manufacturing processes. Domain background (advantage): Slot machines, gaming cabinets, ATMs, self-service kiosks, medical consoles or high-density industrial control panels. 7-10 Yrs Electrical engineering, Component Selection, Connectors, Senior, Wire, Cable Harness, Harness Design, Solid works

jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our performance engineering team. This role provides an opportunity to lead projects and contribute to high-impact software solutions that are used by enterprises and users worldwide. You will work in a collaborative environment, contributing to the technical foundation behind our flagship products and services. Responsibilities: Performance Engineering: Identify performance requirements and risks early in the development lifecycle. Execute load and stress tests, interpret results, analyze performance bottlenecks, and work with the team to improve response times, throughput, and resource utilization. Monitoring and Observability: Build and use monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting to understand service behavior. Define and review service health indicators, use telemetry to detect performance regressions, and make systems easier to diagnose in production. Project Management: Be able to manage performance execution and delivery of features and projects, negotiating project priorities and deadlines, ensuring successful and timely completion, with quality. Code and Runtime Optimization: Analyze application and system behavior to find inefficient code paths or resource usage. Recommend and implement optimizations, then validate their impact through measurement and testing. Performance Troubleshooting: Investigate complex performance issues using profiling and diagnostic tools, including heap and thread dump analysis. Identify root causes and drive fixes and preventive measures. Architectural Design: Participate in or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders, and contribute to the architectural design of new features and systems. Consider scalability, reliability, maintainability, observability, and performance throughout the design process. Mentorship: Provide technical mentorship and guidance to junior engineers, fostering a culture of learning and growth. Code Review: Review code developed by other engineers, provide constructive feedback, and maintain a high bar for technical excellence. Promote coding guidelines, elegant and efficient implementations, maintainability, observability, and unit testing. Testing: Develop and maintain performance test scripts and automation using tools such as LoadRunner, NeoLoad, JMeter, and JavaScript-based frameworks. Debugging and Troubleshooting: Diagnose and resolve technical issues to ensure high-quality service operations. Service Health and Quality: Maintain service health and quality, proactively identifying and resolving issues. Use service health indicators and telemetry to recommend improvements to reliability and performance. Lead thorough root cause analyses and implement measures to prevent recurrence. Documentation: Document new features, enhancements, fixes, and relevant performance findings. Contribute to technical documentation and training materials. Innovation: Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, advocating for their adoption where appropriate to improve innovation and productivity within the team (e.g., Copilot). Minimum Qualifications: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of experience either in software development or performance engineering, preferably in a product-based or SaaS organization. Deep expertise in one or more programming languages such as C, C++, C#, .NET, Python, Java, or JavaScript. Hands-On experience with software development practices and in workload modeling, performance test planning, scripting, test execution, monitoring, and results analysis. Proficiency with performance testing and APM Tools such as LoadRunner, NeoLoad, JMeter, k6, Grafana, Dynatrace. Understanding of cloud technologies and DevOps principles. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment. Preferred Qualifications: Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. Experience with cloud platforms like Azure, AWS, or GCP. Familiarity with GitHub, CI/CD pipelines and automation tools. Knowledge of agile development methodologies. Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide junior engineers. Commitment to continuous learning and professional development. Familiarity with developing accessible technologies. Dedicated to diversity and inclusion initiatives. Work hours: Must be able to overlap with US business hours as required by the team 4-9 Yrs Application, Load runner, Monitoring tools, Application Performance Management, Load, Neoload, Appdynamics, Center

This is the core of the role. ¢ Solid PostgreSQL / SQL and hands-on experience with an ORM Sequelize or Prisma schema design, joins, indexing, transactions, and query optimization. ¢ Experience building third-party integrations and secure APIs, with authentication/authorization using Keycloak (JWT/OAuth2/OIDC). ¢ Working React.js with TypeScript (~30% of the role) hooks, components, state management, and building UI from a Figma design or just an idea. ¢ Experience with Redis (caching/sessions/queues) or a similar in-memory store. ¢ Familiarity with observability and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, Jaeger/Tempo/SigNoz, or similar). ¢ Strong JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals async/await, promises, and the Node.js event loop. Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent practical experience. What We Offer ¢ Ownership of full-stack products end to end backend, frontend, and data. ¢ A modern TypeScript stack (Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, Redis) and room to improve architecture. ¢ A collaborative engineering culture and the chance to mentor a junior team. ¢ Competitive compensation, benefits, and continuous learning support. jobs.title: Agentic AI Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary As an Agentic AI Engineer at Hudson Data, you will design, build, and ship LLM-powered agents that do real work: researching cases, analysing data, calling tools and APIs, and automating multi-step workflows for our products and for lenders and fintech partners. You will own agents end to end, from prompt and tool design through orchestration, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring in production. You will work closely with our data science, data engineering, and product teams, and help set how Hudson Data builds with AI. This is a full-time, onsite role in Gurugram, India. Responsibilities Design and build LLM-based agents and multi-agent workflows that plan, use tools, call APIs and databases, and complete multi-step tasks reliably. Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines over structured and unstructured data, including chunking, embeddings, vector search, and re-ranking. Design clear tool interfaces (function calling, MCP servers) that connect agents to internal systems, data warehouses, and third-party services. Put guardrails in place: permissions, human-in-the-loop review, prompt-injection defences, PII handling, and audit trails suitable for financial-services clients. Choose the right model for each job across providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, open-weight models), balancing quality, cost, and latency. Work with data scientists to combine agents with predictive models, for example agents that investigate fraud alerts or explain credit decisions. Keep up with a fast-moving field and bring the useful ideas into our stack. Required qualifications 3+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 1 year building applications on top of LLMs. Strong Python, with experience building production backend services and APIs (FastAPI or similar). Hands-on experience building agents or LLM workflows: function/tool calling, structured outputs, prompt design, and at least one orchestration approach (e.g. LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or your own). Experience with RAG and vector databases (e.g. pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant). Experience evaluating LLM systems and improving them based on measured results. Solid SQL and comfort working with real, messy business data. Experience with cloud platforms (GCP or AWS), Docker, Git, and CI/CD. Ability to own problems end to end and explain technical trade-offs clearly. Preferred qualifications Bachelors or Masters degree in computer science or a related field. Experience building MCP servers or integrating agents with enterprise systems. Experience with observability tools for LLM apps (e.g. LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, OpenTelemetry). Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with AI researchers, frontend developers, and product teams to ship impactful features rapidly and iteratively. Preferred Candidate Profile: Experience: Minimum 2 years in backend development with at least 1 year of hands-on experience working with LLMs or NLP systems. Programming Skills: Proficient in Python with practical exposure to asynchronous programming and frameworks like FastAPI or Django. LLM Ecosystem Expertise: Experience with tools and libraries such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers, and OpenAI/Anthropic APIs. Database Knowledge: Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, including schema design and performance optimization. Model Engineering: Familiarity with prompt design, LLM fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT), and evaluation metrics for language models. Cloud Deployment: Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) and building serverless or containerized deployments. NLP Understanding: Solid grasp of NLP concepts including intent detection, dialogue management, and text classification. Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to translate business problems into AI-first solutions with a user-centric approach.
